notes: When something you ask for needs Crisp Pro — Max quality, or a second job while one is running — Crisp now always opens the unlock window with Buy, never a message you can’t act on. Photos are sized from their own size: “make it 4K” on a 1080p photo makes it 4K, not 8K; “make it 1080p” on a small photo really reaches 1080p; and a photo that’s already the size you ask for is told so instead of being upscaled again.
